observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 are identical images of a gas cooker with an oven.
The appliance has a stainless steel front panel with a black glass oven door and a black stovetop.
There are four burners on the stovetop, arranged in two rows of two.
Five control knobs are visible on the front panel, with symbols indicating burner and oven functions.
The brand name 'MAXI' is visible on the right side of the control panel in photo 0 and photo 1.
The oven door has a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI SUNDAY MUYIWA'.
The stovetop appears to have some residue or grime, especially around the burners.
The appliance is placed on a tiled floor, with a green plastic item and patterned wall visible in the background.
No visible damage to the body or door, but the glass top above the burners is slightly dirty or smudged.
